## Aswan International Airport

Aswan International Airport is a large airport in Aswan, Egypt. The airport is located at latitude 23.96110 and longitude 32.82040. The airport has one runway: 17/35. The ICAO airport code of this field is HESN. The airport's IATA code is ASW. Nearby other airfields are Darau Airport, Abu Rahal Well Airport, Luxor International Airport, Abu Simbel Airport and Marsa Alam International Airport. [...] METAR
